abstract: Proteins binding to the PEA3 enhancer motif (AGGAAG) activate the polyomavirus early promoter and help comprise the viral late mRNA initiator element (W. Yoo, M. E. Martin, and W. R. Folk, J. Virol. 65:5391-5400, 1991). Because many developmentally regulated cellular genes have PEA3 motifs near their promoter sequences, and because Ets family gene products activate the PEA3 motif, we have studied the expression of PEA3-binding proteins and Ets-related proteins during differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. An approximately 91-kDa protein (PEA3-91) was identified in F9 cell nuclear extracts by UV cross-linking to a radiolabeled PEA3 oligonucleotide probe, and expression of PEA3-91 was down-regulated after differentiation of F9 cells to parietal endoderm. The c-ets-1 gene product binds to a sequence in the murine sarcoma virus long terminal repeat that is similar to the PEA3 motif (cGGAAG), but PEA3-91 was not cross-linked to this Ets-1-binding motif, nor did antiserum which recognizes murine c-ets-1 and c-ets-2 proteins have any effect on PEA3-binding activity in mobility shift assays. Furthermore, c-ets-1 mRNA was not detected in undifferentiated or differentiated F9 cells, and c-ets-2 mRNA levels remained high after differentiation. Antiserum against the Drosophila Ets-related E74A protein, however, recognized an approximately 92-kDa protein in F9 cells whose expression during differentiation varied in a manner identical to that of PEA3-91. These data suggest that PEA3-91 is not the product of the ets-1 or ets-2 genes but is likely to be the product of a murine homolog of the Drosophila E74 gene.
abstract_ja: PEA3エンハンサーモチーフ(AGGAAG)に結合する蛋白は、ポリオーマウイルス初期プロモーターを活性化し、ウイルス後期mRNAの開始エレメントの構成にも関与する。多くの発生制御遺伝子がプロモーター近傍にPEA3モチーフを持つため、我々はF9胎児性癌細胞の分化過程におけるPEA3結合蛋白とEts関連蛋白の発現を調べた。紫外線架橋法により、F9細胞の核抽出液中に約91kDaの蛋白(PEA3-91)が同定され、壁側内胚葉への分化に伴いその発現は低下した。c-ets-1遺伝子産物はマウス肉腫ウイルス長末端反復配列中の類似配列に結合するが、PEA3-91はこの配列に架橋されず、マウスc-ets-1およびc-ets-2蛋白を認識する抗血清もPEA3結合活性に影響しなかった。さらにc-ets-1 mRNAは未分化・分化細胞のいずれでも検出されず、c-ets-2 mRNAは分化後も高いレベルを維持した。一方、ショウジョウバエのEts関連蛋白E74Aに対する抗血清はF9細胞中の約92kDa蛋白を認識し、その発現変動はPEA3-91と同一であった。これらのデータは、PEA3-91がets-1またはets-2遺伝子の産物ではなく、ショウジョウバエE74遺伝子のマウス相同遺伝子の産物である可能性が高いことを示唆する。
